skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of tourism policy and planning.
Analyze the impact of tourism policies on sustainable development.
Provide an overview of the history and current issues in tourism policy.
Manage tourism sustainably with responsible practices.
Evaluate potential and conditions for tourism planning.
Utilize tools and techniques in tourism planning.
Analyze future trends in tourism policy and planning.
Apply critical thinking skills to assess resources and contexts for policy and planning.
Demonstrate ability to update knowledge, take responsibility, and be creative during individual and group discussions.
Present findings effectively in group presentations.
